svg.title: Proof. Homogeneity and concavity of the true Vt−1 imply P i γo,iLt−1(qo,i) ≤Vt−1(zo). Every phys- ical circle point lies in the convex hull of the polygon vertices. Concavity of the true Qt gives mina∈vert PN Qt(w, a) ≤mina∈S1 Qt(w, a) = Vt(w). Combining the two inequalities proves the backup. In particular, no concavity of a chosen piecewise-linear interpolant is asserted or needed. The argument first compares the true Qt on the outer polygon, then bounds its vertex values individually. Random schedules and feedback coins are covered because a Bayes minimum over randomized policies cannot be smaller than the minimum over its deterministic components.
